descriptions.zh:
随着越来越多的太空文明彼此间建立了正式的关系，星系之中愈发生机盎然。为了避免国家间出现悲剧性的误解，越来越多的外交人士呼吁设立一个新的泛星系组织——如果愿意的话也可以称为共同体，在那里星系中的各帝国可以召开会议，共商星系大事。

[Root.GetName]应该承诺支持§H星海共同体§!的创立吗？
descriptions.en:
As more and more spacefaring civilizations establish formal relations with one another, the galaxy is becoming a vibrant and lively place. To avoid tragic misunderstandings between nations, an increasing number of diplomats have called for the establishment of a new pan-galactic organization - a community, if you will, where the empires of the galaxy can meet to discuss important matters.

Should the [Root.GetName] pledge its support for the creation of the §HGalactic Community§!?

descriptions.zh: 让我们再试一次。我们应该组建星海共同体吗？
descriptions.en: Let's try again. Should we form a Galactic Community?

label.zh: 是的，值得进行这样的尝试。
label.en: Yes, this is a worthy endeavor.

tooltips.zh: 我们将支持建立星海共同体。
tooltips.en: We will support the creation of the Galactic Community.

label.zh: 不，我们没时间做这种毫无意义的事情。
label.en: No, we have no time for this nonsense.

tooltips.zh: 我们将不支持建立星海共同体。
tooltips.en: We will not support the creation of the Galactic Community.

titles.en: The Birth of the Galactic Community

descriptions.zh:
这是历史性的一天。星系中数个重要的太空帝国，包括[Root.GetName]，宣布了§H星海共同体§!的创立。这一国家间组织会作为一个论坛，整个星系的事务都可以在此讨论和决定。

作为其创始成员国之一，我们可以为星系历史的这一里程碑感到骄傲。
descriptions.en:
This is a historic day. Several of the galaxy's prominent spacefaring empires, including the [Root.GetName], have announced the creation of the §HGalactic Community§!. This supranational organization will serve as a forum where matters involving the entire galaxy can be discussed and decided upon.

As one of its founding members, we can take pride in this milestone of galactic history.

label.en: A great day for the galaxy!

titles.en: The Birth of the Galactic Community

descriptions.zh:
尽管我们决定不为建立某种国家间星系机构提供帮助，若干其他帝国已经联合创立了这种东西。在他们“历史性的”联合声明中，他们向全星系宣布了§H星海共同体§!的创立。这一组织的目的是作为一个论坛，会影响星系整体的重要事务可以在那里讨论。

由于我们拒绝参与这一星海共同体的创立，[Root.GetName]将不被算作成员国。
descriptions.en:
Despite our decision not to lend our support behind the founding of some sort of supranational galactic institution, several other empires have banded together to create just such a thing. In their "historic" joint announcement, they declared the creation of the §HGalactic Community§! to the galaxy. This organization is to serve as a forum where important matters that affect the galaxy as a whole can be discussed.

As we refused to take part in the creation of this Galactic Community, the [Root.GetName] is not yet considered a member.

descriptions.zh: 组建一个超国家的“§H星海共同体§!”的提议已经失败。并没有足够的帝国承诺会支持这种机构的创立。
descriptions.en: The initiative to form a supranational "§HGalactic Community§!" has failed. Not enough empires pledged their support to the creation of such an institution.

label.en: The other fools were not ready.

titles.en: The Birth of the Galactic Community

descriptions.zh:
数个太空帝国，其中一些我们尚不清楚，已经联合组建了一个“§H星海共同体§!”。这一国家间机构的目的是作为一个论坛，在那里可以共商重要事务。

虽然我们并不曾参与其建立，那些成员国已经向[Root.GetName]发出了邀请，请求我们成为正式的成员国。我们应该接受邀请吗？
descriptions.en:
Several spacefaring empires, some of them unknown to us, have banded together to form a "§HGalactic Community§!." This supranational institution is to serve as a forum where important matters can be discussed.

Although we were not involved in its founding, the other members have extended an invitation to the [Root.GetName] for formal membership. Should we accept?

label.zh: 好的，让我们加入这一组织。
label.en: Yes, let us join this community.

label.zh: 不，我们不会参与这种事。
label.en: No, we will take no part in this.

label.zh: 我们不关心什么“共同体”
label.en: We do not care for this "Community."

label.zh: 不久后他们也将臣服于我们的大可汗。
label.en: Soon they too will bow to our great Khan.

descriptions.zh:
星海共同体的各个成员国已经投票决定设立星系理事会。这一受人尊敬的实体只允许社群中三个实力最强、最具影响力的帝国成为其成员。到下一轮议会被选出为止，这三个国家将是§H[council_member_1.GetName]§!，§H[council_member_2.GetName]§!和§H[council_member_3.GetName]§!。

共同体期望理事会成员国可以领导和保卫整个星海共同体。他们获得了提权，可以跳过那些时常在大型政治机构中阻碍决策流程的繁文缛节。
descriptions.en:
The members of the Galactic Community have voted to establish a Galactic Council. Membership in this august body will be limited to representatives from the three most powerful and influential empires in the Community. Until a new Council is elected, these are the §H[council_member_1.GetName]§!, the §H[council_member_2.GetName]§!, and the §H[council_member_3.GetName]§!.

The members of the Council are expected to lead and safeguard the Galactic Community. Their increased powers allow them to cut through some of the red tape that so often inhibits the decision-making process in large political institutions.

label.zh: 希望他们有能力完成任务……
label.en: Hopefully they are up to the task...

label.zh: 现在我们终于可以大有作为了！
label.en: Now we can finally get things done!

label.zh: 啊，看来那些幕后操纵者总算露出了真容！
label.en: Ah, so the puppeteers finally reveal themselves!

titles.zh: [galactic_market_station_system.GetName]泛星系贸易市场总部被拆除

descriptions.zh: 根据[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]宪章第19条C款，只有一个会员国可以主办泛星系贸易市场。因此，市场在[galactic_market_station_system.GetName]星系的总部已经被拆除。最后一位交易员在今天不情愿地放弃了他们的岗位，哀叹这一戏剧性的——在他们看来——不必要的步骤对星系贸易造成了巨大的破坏。[global_event_country.GetCommunityOrImperium]的贸易董事会已提出陈词对该事态表示遗憾。他们允诺，在[global_event_country.GetCommunityOrImperium]内新主办国的选举将会很快开始。
descriptions.en: According to article 19C of the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]'s charter, only a member state may host the Galactic Market. As such, the market's headquarters in the [galactic_market_station_system.GetName] system has been dismantled. The last traders reluctantly abandoned their posts today, bemoaning the massive disruption to galactic trade that this dramatic and - in their view - needless step has caused. The [global_event_country.GetCommunityOrImperium]'s Board of Commerce has issued a statement expressing regret for this state of affairs. They promise that nominations for a new host within the [global_event_country.GetCommunityOrImperium] will commence immediately.

label.en: It is a price worth paying.

options.script:
name = galcom.62.A
remove_modifier = galactic_market_founder

titles.zh: 挑选泛星系贸易市场新总部
titles.en: New Headquarters for Galactic Market Sought

descriptions.zh: 随着[From.GetName]选择离开[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]，我们不得不执行[global_event_country.GetCommunityOrImperium]宪章中的一项晦涩难懂的条款，其大意是只有成员国才能主导泛星系贸易市场。因此，市场在[galactic_market_station_system.GetName]星系的总部已经被拆除。最后一位交易员在今天不情愿地放弃了他们的岗位，哀叹这一戏剧性的——在他们看来——不必要的步骤对星系贸易造成了巨大的破坏。对新总部的选址提名已经开始，[global_event_country.GetCommunityOrImperium]的商务董事会发布生命对当前形势表示遗憾。他们保障将尽快找到新的主办国。
descriptions.en: With the [From.GetName] opting to leave the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium], an obscure article of the [global_event_country.GetCommunityOrImperium]'s charter must be applied, to the effect that only a member state may host the Galactic Market. As such, the market's headquarters in the [galactic_market_station_system.GetName] system has been dismantled. The last traders reluctantly abandoned their posts today, bemoaning the massive disruption to galactic trade that this dramatic and - in their view - needless step has caused. Nominations for the headquarters' new location have already opened, with the [global_event_country.GetCommunityOrImperium]'s Board of Commerce expressing regret for this state of affairs. They promise that a new host will be found swiftly.

label.zh: 也许这对我们而言是一次机会……
label.en: Perhaps this represents an opportunity for us...

tooltips.zh: §H解锁决议：§!提名泛星系贸易市场中心
tooltips.en: §HUnlocks Decision:§! Nominate for Galactic Market Hub

label.zh: 那我们只能嘲笑他们的愚蠢了。
label.en: We can only laugh at their foolishness.

tooltips.zh: §H解锁决议：§!提名泛星系贸易市场中心
tooltips.en: §HUnlocks Decision:§! Nominate for Galactic Market Hub

descriptions.zh:
缇扬奇已被宣布为星系害兽。任何境内有缇扬奇的星海共同体成员国都有法律义务确保这些生物被即刻消灭。

不幸的是，我国境内就有缇扬奇存在。直至它们被处理掉或是自动离开我国境内为止，[Root.GetName]将被视为§R违反星系法§!。
descriptions.en:
The Tiyanki have officially been declared galactic pests. Any member of the Galactic Community with Tiyanki inside their borders are legally obliged to see to the immediate euthanization of the creatures.

Unfortunately, there are Tiyanki present within our space. Until they are dealt with, or they leave our space of their own accord, the [Root.GetName] will be considered in §RBreach of Galactic Law§!.

label.zh: 这些害虫必须尽快处理。
label.en: This infestation must be dealt with.

descriptions.zh:
一只缇扬奇越过边境，进入了我国的§H[tiyanki_system.GetName]§!星系。由于缇扬奇已被宣布为星系害兽，任何境内有缇扬奇的星海共同体成员国都有法律义务确保这些生物被即刻消灭。

[Root.GetName]将被视为§R违反星系法§!，直至缇扬奇被处理掉或是自动离开我国境内为止。
descriptions.en:
A Tiyanki pod has crossed into our space in the §H[tiyanki_system.GetName]§! system. As the Tiyanki have officially been declared galactic pests, all Galactic Community members are legally obliged to immediately euthanize any creatures present within their borders.

The [Root.GetName] will be considered in §RBreach of Galactic Law§! until the Tiyanki have either departed our space or been exterminated.

label.zh: 这些害虫必须尽快处理。
label.en: This infestation must be dealt with.

descriptions.zh:
星海共同体的官员就我们最近在§H[tiyanki_kill_system.GetName]§!星系击杀缇扬奇提出抗议，通知我们我国的行为违反了缇扬奇保护法。结果是，[Root.GetName]将在接下来10年内被视为§R违反星系法§!。

我们从缇扬奇尸体上提取的资源被收缴了，而且他们还对我国处以罚金。
descriptions.en:
Officials from the Galactic Community have protested our recent killing of Tiyanki in the §H[tiyanki_kill_system.GetName]§! system, informing us that our actions have violated the Tiyanki Conservation Act. As a consequence, the [Root.GetName] is to be considered in §RBreach of Galactic Law§! for the next ten years.

The resources we extracted from the dead Tiyanki have been confiscated, and we have been issued a fine.

options.script:
name = galcom.107.a
add_resource = { energy = -1000 }

descriptions.zh: 星海共同体的官员注意到[Root.GetName]境内有缇扬奇存在。由于缇扬奇害兽管制议案已经生效，这使得我国处于§R违反星系法§!状态，直至这些生物被消灭或是自行主动离开为止。
descriptions.en: Officials from the Galactic Community have observed the presence of Tiyanki within the borders of the [Root.GetName]. With the Tiyanki Pest Control resolution having been enacted, this leaves us in §RBreach of Galactic Law§! until the creatures are euthanized or leave our space of their own accord.

label.zh: 这些害虫必须尽快处理。
label.en: This infestation must be dealt with.

descriptions.zh:
星海共同体的官员收到了我们最近就缇扬奇族母取得胜利的消息。他们告诉我方，消灭这只野兽明显违反了缇扬奇保护法，就算缇扬奇族母是敌对生物也一样。

[Root.GetName]将在接下来十年内被视为§R违反星系法§!。此外，我们收到了一份巨额的罚单，理由是我们消灭了“一种独特的，整个星系中再也见不到的缇扬奇生命形式”。
descriptions.en:
Officials from the Galactic Community have received word of our recent victory against the Tiyanki Matriarch. They have informed us that our destruction of the beast was a clear violation of the Tiyanki Conservation Act, regardless of the Matriarch's hostile nature.

The [Root.GetName] will be considered in §RBreach of Galactic Law§! for the next ten years. Additionally, we have been issued with a hefty fine for our killing of "a unique Tiyanki life form whose like the galaxy shall never see again."

label.en: It had to be put down.

label.zh: 但是……是它攻击我们的啊！

titles.zh: 挑选泛星系贸易市场新总部
titles.en: New Headquarters for Galactic Market Sought

descriptions.zh:
[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]已经表态，迁移泛星系贸易市场的新一轮竞争由此展开。位于[market_founder_planet.solar_system.GetName]星系的的市场总部已经开始收尾工作，交易员的关注都集中在未来几年的预测上。他们哀叹这一戏剧性的——且在他们看来并不必要的决定对泛星系贸易造成了巨大的破坏。

总部新址的提名已经开始，[global_event_country.GetCommunityOrImperium]的商业委员会发表了一份声明，对这种状况表示遗憾。他们承诺将尽快找到一个新的星系。
descriptions.en:
The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has spoken, and a new competition has begun to relocate the Galactic Market. The market's headquarters in the [market_founder_planet.solar_system.GetName] system has begun wind-down operations, with traders focusing solely on forecasts for the next few years. They bemoan the massive disruption to galactic trade that this dramatic and - in their view - needless step has already caused.

Nominations for the headquarters' new location have already opened, with the [global_event_country.GetCommunityOrImperium]'s Board of Commerce issuing a statement expressing regret at this state of affairs. They promise that a new host will be found swiftly.

label.zh: 这将使我们的成员切实收益。
label.en: This may indeed benefit our members.

titles.zh: 泛星系贸易市场留在原址

descriptions.zh:
我们迁移泛星系贸易市场的动议不幸失败。尽管我们的努力争取到了大量口头支持，却没有转化为新地点的足够提名。

这一意见原则上仍然合理：[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]今后还是可以再次提出迁移市场。然而就目前而言，这个商业机构仍然由获利丰厚的[market_founder.GetName]进行管理。
descriptions.en:
Our motion to relocate the Galactic Market has unfortunately failed. While we mustered significant vocal support for the endeavor, this did not translate into enough valid nominations for a new host site.

The idea remains sound in principle: the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] may propose moving the Market again in future, if it so desires. For now though, this commercial institution remains in the lucrative care of the [market_founder.GetName].

titles.zh: 泛星系贸易市场留在原址

descriptions.zh: 泛星系商业最近经历了一次短暂而混乱的复苏，有消息称迁移泛星系市场的努力已经失败。尽管[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]声明希望迁移这一机构，但他们没有收到任何替代东道主的可靠提名。因此，[market_founder.GetName]将继续担任其东道主，直到政治变革的风向再次转向，通过投票寻找到替代。
descriptions.en: Galactic commerce experienced a brief and confusing resurgence recently, with news that the effort to relocate the Galactic Market has failed. Despite the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]'s stated desire to move this institution, they received no valid nominations for a replacement host. As a result, the [market_founder.GetName] shall remain its hosts until the winds of political change swing back to polling for a replacement.

descriptions.zh:
泛星系的政治意愿显然与其市场的意愿不一致。在引起了广泛的金融混乱之后，[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]想要取消我们作为其专属交易中心东道主的努力已经失败，因为没有其他帝国给出有效的东道主提名。

这项动议的支持者们不为所动，断言泛星系市场随时可能根据商业需要进行迁移到别处。不过就目前而言，在经历了这么多忙乱之后，泛星系最重要的商人们还是更愿意相信我们。
descriptions.en:
The galaxy's political will is clearly not aligned with that of its markets. After having caused widespread financial upset, the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]'s effort to remove us as hosts to its dedicated trading hub has failed, with no other empires putting forward a valid nomination for a host site.

Proponents of this motion are unfazed, affirming that the Galactic Market may yet move wherever and whenever commercial needs dictate. For now though, it would seem that after all that fuss, the galaxy's foremost merchants prefer to keep their trust in us.

descriptions.zh: 我们对[market_founder_planet.GetName]进行的推广宣传有了收获，而贸易巨头们决定将大部分商业活动集中在[market_founder_planet.GetStarName]星系内！
descriptions.en: Our marketing campaign on [market_founder_planet.GetName] has borne fruit, and the market-powers-that-be have seen fit to centralize much of their activity within the [market_founder_planet.GetStarName] system!

tooltips.zh: §H泛星系贸易市场空间站§!已成立于§Y[galactic_market_station.solar_system.GetName]§!星系
tooltips.en: §HGalactic Market Station§! established in the §Y[galactic_market_station.solar_system.GetName]§! system
